User.title: User Profile
User.description: User account subscription details, billing info, and plan state

tier.description: Subscription tier: gold-badge pro or standard free

trialEnd.description: Timestamp when the 3-day free trial on registration ends

stripeCustomerId.description: Stripe Customer ID used for payment mapping

Offer.title: Collaboration Offer
Offer.description: Premium brand partner offer including direct base URL, instructions, action required, rewards description, and priority level

requiredAction.description: Specific action the user must fulfill on the partner's platform

partner_url_base.description: The target partner URL template (ref and token will be appended)

isProOnly.description: Priority tier lock condition for Pro subscribers

rewardPool.description: Hidden reward code (e.g. coupon, voucher, Nitro invitation) only shown for claimed state

Claim.title: User Claim Request
Claim.description: Tracks target offer, active tokens, and completion/payout details

claimId.description: Unique generated claim document ID or UUID

token.description: Unique verification token generated for verification

reward.description: The custom code voucher revealed on verification

/users/{uid}.description: User accounts tier tracking and metadata

/claims/{uid}/userClaims/{claimId}.description: User specific claims registry containing state and claims status
